name: Media Hero Slider
description: This app will populate the universal implementation of a "Hero Slider" to be used on the homepage in most cases. A rich hero slider that allows you to display video and/or image slides.
version_note: Deprecated (info.yml lifecycle: deprecated, package 'Varbase (deprecated)'). Documented installed+enabled. The module itself ships only templates, JS libraries, a hook_theme/preprocess module file, and an install helper; it defines NO routes, permissions, services, plugin types, or config/install. The Hero-slider content type, fields, view, entityqueue, slick optionset, tour and rabbit_hole settings ship as a Drupal recipe under recipes/default/ and are created by applying that recipe (drush recipe), NOT by enabling the module. On this site the module was enabled but the recipe was not applied, so node type varbase_heroslider_media does not exist at runtime.
project_description:
Populates the universal implementation of a "Hero Slider" to be used on the homepage in most cases.

 A rich hero slider that allow Content Admins to display video and/or image slides.
